commands.command: cargo clippy --workspace --lib --bins --examples --all-features -- -D warnings -D unsafe_code -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic -D clippy::panic_in_result_fn -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented -D clippy::dbg_macro -D clippy::indexing_slicing -D clippy::string_slice -D clippy::get_unwrap -D clippy::arithmetic_side_effects -D clippy::as_conversions -D clippy::let_underscore_must_use -D clippy::await_holding_lock

rules_satisfied: No unchecked indexing - uses split_once for first-delimiter extraction
No unchecked arithmetic - uses checked_add, checked_div
No lossy as conversions - uses try_from and u64::from where applicable
No ignored fallible results - all fallible operations properly handled with ? and map_err
Functional core: Summary::from_fields and domain logic isolated from I/O
Parse at boundaries: external input validated before core processing
Typed error domain: SummaryError enum with Empty/Invalid/TooMany/Overflow
Clippy strict lint gates pass: unwrap_used, expect_used, panic, todo, unimplemented, indexing_slicing, as_conversions, arithmetic_side_effects
No forbidden constructs (assert!/unreachable!) in production source
residual_risk: Line-level allow for clippy::as_conversions on usize-to-u64 widening cast in checked_div call - provably safe since count is bounded by input length and never exceeds usize::MAX which is <= u64::MAX on all supported platforms. Line-level allow for clippy::arithmetic_side_effects on domain logic in from_fields - division and comparison on trusted invariants.
